3D Coordinate-Aware Head CT/MR Defacing

Source: R/deid-deface.R
dicom_deface.Rd

Removes recognizable facial features (nose, jaw, facial profile) from 3D cranial CT and MR volumes using orientation-invariant physical RAS coordinates, while guaranteeing that deep intracranial brain parenchyma remains completely untouched.

Usage

dicom_deface(
  x,
  out_dir = NULL,
  fill = c("auto", "air", "zero"),
  surface_depth_mm = 35,
  nasion_fraction = 0.55,
  tragus_fraction = 0.5,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A dicom_volume object, or a character string / vector specifying a DICOM directory or slice file paths.

out_dir

Optional directory path where defaced DICOM slice files will be written. If NULL (default), no files are written.

fill

Method or numeric scalar to fill masked facial voxels: "auto" (-1000 HU for CT, 0 for MR), "air" (-1000), "zero" (0), or a numeric scalar value.

surface_depth_mm

Numeric scalar. Maximum superficial depth (in millimeters) from the anterior air-skin surface to mask. Tissue deeper than this limit is guaranteed untouched. Default is 35 mm.

nasion_fraction

Numeric scalar between 0 and 1. Fraction of the head's inferior-to-superior span defining the superior boundary of facial defacing (nasion plane). Default is 0.55.

tragus_fraction

Numeric scalar between 0 and 1. Fraction of the head's anterior-to-posterior span defining the posterior boundary of the facial bevel (tragus plane). Default is 0.50.

...

Additional arguments passed to internal methods.

Value

A modified dicom_volume object with facial voxels replaced by the fill value, and a provenance record appended. When out_dir is provided, written DICOM slice files carry:

  • RecognizableVisualFeatures (0028,0302) == "NO"

  • ImageType (0008,0008) starting with "DERIVED\SECONDARY"

  • Fresh SOPInstanceUID (0008,0018) and MediaStorageSOPInstanceUID (0002,0003)

  • CID 7050 code "113102" (Clean Recognizable Visual Features Option) stamped in DeidentificationMethodCodeSequence (0012,0064).

Details

The defacing algorithm operates in physical RAS world coordinates derived via to_ras(vol)$affine, ensuring that facial geometry is computed consistently regardless of whether the volume was acquired axially, sagittally, or coronally. The algorithm defines an anterior-inferior facial bevel half-space bounded by the nasion and tragus planes, restricted to superficial tissue within surface_depth_mm of the anterior air-skin boundary.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
vol <- read_dicom_volume("path/to/head_ct")
defaced <- dicom_deface(vol, out_dir = "path/to/defaced_ct")
} # }
